policy.repair_policy: Diagnostic repairs/retries only after invalid outputs or operational failures. Stop at the first valid assessment; no reference label is supplied or used for retries.
policy.scoring: Primary estimate exact agreement; errors and unknowns count as nonmatches over all items. Also retain single-label comparison against the reference. First-pass and post-repair results are reported separately.
policy.family_grouping: Explicit family_id if present, otherwise question_id; final 30-item set contains distinct underlying code families.
policy.original_authoring_target_metrics: Unavailable: final dataset omits original requested levels and reference match decisions. Do not fabricate false-acceptance/rejection or 4x4 decision confusion.
policy.eligibility: All approved questions included; no additional correctness checks or execution.
policy.human_agreement: AI-assisted single-human reference; independent human-human agreement unavailable.
policy.held_out: Configuration frozen before all calls. Prior v2 seed questions and AI recommendations exist in branch history; this is not an untouched external benchmark. No within-run replacements or prompt tuning. A followup_of value identifies a requested repeat of an inspected collection, not fresh confirmatory validation.
policy.alpha: Two-rater ordinal Krippendorff alpha with pooled marginal midrank distances, implementation in this runner v1; unknowns omitted from pairs.
policy.intervals: 2000 whole-family percentile bootstrap replicates; random.Random seed 43.
